correctness.finding: PASS. In the one-positive chamber the exponential-density representation gives f(0)=s^{-1}∏(1+p_j)^{-1}, with s=(1+Σp_j^2)^(-1/2). Dividing by the facet-parallel value and using the exact angle identity yields the stated sec(theta) factorization; AM-GM gives the sharp chamber inequality and inverse chordal-distance bound. On a zero-coordinate boundary stratum the density reduces to the corresponding m-coordinate problem, producing B_{n,m}; a two-value interior critical point gives R_{n,k} by the gamma-convolution calculation. Combined with Ambrus–Gárgyán's critical-point classification, these finite families give the stated sublevel gap rho_n>1. For the Hessian, differentiating along a unit spherical geodesic gives -(n-2)+(n-1)+(n-1)/n=(2n-1)/n, so the log-volume Hessian is isotropic with exactly the claimed eigenvalue. Independent numerical evaluation gives rho_n>1 for n=3 through 14.
